---
title: "API reference"
subtitle: "Every public function, generated from the package itself"
toc-depth: 2
---

Signatures and documentation below are read from the installed package at render
time, so they cannot drift from the code.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import inspect
import textwrap
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

import empiricalcalibration as ec


def anchor(name):
    return name.lower()


def render(names, heading_level=3):
    out = []
    for name in names:
        obj = getattr(ec, name)
        try:
            sig = str(inspect.signature(obj))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            sig = ""
        doc = inspect.getdoc(obj) or "*(no docstring)*"
        hashes = "#" * heading_level
        out.append(
            f'{hashes} `{name}` {{#{anchor(name)}}}\n\n'
            f"```python\n{name}{sig}\n```\n\n"
            f"{doc}\n"
        )
    display(Markdown("\n".join(out)))
```

## Random number generation

`ec.set_seed(n)` reproduces R's `set.seed(n)` stream exactly, so stochastic
functions match R run-for-run. See [Validation](../validation.qmd).

```{python}
#| echo: false
render(["set_seed", "get_generator"])
```

## Datasets

```{python}
#| echo: false
lines = ["| dataset | rows | columns |", "|---|---|---|"]
for name in ["sccs", "caseControl", "cohortMethod",
             "southworthReplication", "grahamReplication"]:
    df = getattr(ec.datasets, name)()
    cols = ", ".join(f"`{c}`" for c in df.columns)
    lines.append(f"| `ec.datasets.{name}()` | {len(df)} | {cols} |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(lines)))
```

Each accessor returns a fresh `DataFrame`, so mutating one does not affect the
package's copy. `ec.datasets.load(name)` takes the name as a string.

```{python}
ec.datasets.sccs().head()
```
